title: Japanese Oat Pudding
description: A Japanese-inspired oat pudding dessert with a unique twist.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine oats, milk, and pandan extract (if using).
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, whisking occasionally.
Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, until oats have absorbed most of the liquid, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in honey until dissolved.
Let cool slightly, then stir in energizing granola.
Spoon into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional granola or a drizzle of honey (if desired).
